body:
# 🌙 **BHL Midnight**

**BHL Midnight** is a dark-mode Minecraft resource pack made _specifically_ for Minecraft Blockey Hockey on play.blockey.net

It subtly retextures bright and high-contrast blocks to create a darker & smoother visual experience without modifying Minecraft’s actual lighting system. This keeps gameplay mechanics untouched while making the game easier on the eyes, reducing glare and visual fatigue.

**Perfect for**:

🌑 Dark rooms

🌙 Late-night gaming sessions

🏒 Blockey Hockey players who want visual comfort without distraction
